summary: v1.5 testing PASSED end-to-end. Backend 21/21 (6 new v1.5 + 15 regression). Frontend 3/3 flows verified: (1) /contact/edit/{id} route: loads contact, header renders 'Modifica contatto', save button labeled 'Salva modifiche', all fields populated (c-first-name, c-last-name, c-phone, c-email, c-street, c-number), submit sends PUT and redirects to /contact/{id}; verified partial update preserves untouched fields (last_name, email) via GET. (2) Settings (owner) shows all 3 new controls: settings-app-name input, apt-type-input + apt-type-add, prod-cat-input + prod-cat-add. Adding an appointment type persists via PUT /api/settings and renders chip; adding a product category renders card with subcategory input. (3) Sub-user (sub1@dalpastro.it) DOES NOT see any of settings-app-name / apt-type-* / prod-cat-* — only profile card + logout. Backend RBAC verified: sub-user PUT /api/settings → 403; sub-user GET /api/settings → 200 (shared tenant). Deprecated shadow*/pointerEvents RN Web console warnings persist (non-blocking, carried over from v1.2).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' persists in RN Web 0.76+. Non-blocking. Reference: card styles across app.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking.

React warning: 'A component is changing an uncontrolled input to be controlled' still appears on <input type="date"> when editing a contact whose birth_date starts empty. Cosmetic; carried over from v1.2. Reference: /app/frontend/app/contact/new.tsx c-birth-date-web branch.

action_items: Optional (non-blocking): migrate shadow* → boxShadow / elevation to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
Optional (non-blocking): initialize birth_date state to '' at mount so <input type='date'> is controlled from first render.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:168-175 SettingsModel adds app_name (default 'Dal Pastro CRM'), custom_appointment_types: List[str], custom_product_categories: List[Dict[str, Any]] — loose Dict[str,Any] means the FE can store any shape (currently {name, subs:[]}). Fine for now but consider a typed Pydantic sub-model for stronger validation if UI keeps evolving.
server.py:465-475 PUT /api/settings enforces is_owner(user) → 403 for sub-users; upsert on {user_id: owner.user_id}. Correct multi-tenant behavior.

contact/edit/[id].tsx is a 7-line thin wrapper importing NewContactScreen — good reuse. new.tsx:19-21 reads useLocalSearchParams<{id?:string}> and toggles isEdit. new.tsx:145-149 branches to PUT vs POST correctly. new.tsx:184 & :404 swap header title and button label based on isEdit.

impostazioni.tsx:32-82 persistAndReload optimistically updates settings state and PUTs on every add/remove — good UX. All 3 customization sections gated on !user?.parent_user_id which correctly hides them for sub-users.

MINOR: impostazioni.tsx stores subcategories under key 'subs' while my backend test used 'subcategories'. Backend accepts both since field is List[Dict[str,Any]], but any future analytics/query on that field must know that the FE-canonical key is 'subs'. Suggest documenting the schema in code.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test data: 1 PWTEST_ contact created + deleted; 1 PWTEST_APT_ appointment type + 1 PWTEST_CAT_ product category added then settings reset to defaults via PUT /api/settings. No persistent seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Viewport 390x844. testIDs verified: auth-email-input, auth-password-input, auth-submit-button, logout-btn; edit form: c-first-name, c-last-name, c-birth-date-web, c-phone, c-email, c-street, c-number, c-save-btn; settings: settings-app-name, apt-type-input, apt-type-add, prod-cat-input, prod-cat-add. localStorage token key is 'auth_token_v1' stored as JSON-quoted string (use JSON.parse). Sub-user credentials: sub1@dalpastro.it / Sub12345!. Backend product_categories on Appointment is List[str] (category names only) — do NOT nest objects. Settings.custom_product_categories items use key 'subs' (frontend canonical), not 'subcategories'.
